title: [feature] Ability to change sticky notes font color
line: Sticky notes have a new "Text color: Custom" option in their settings, so their text can be made readable on any wallpaper.
explanation: A sticky note's text and button color was fixed by its color scheme (dark text, or #dfdfdf for Black and Transparent Light), so a transparent note could be unreadable on a black or busy wallpaper and there was no way to change it. The change adds a "Text color:" entry (Custom checkbox with a color button beside it, like the Binary Clock's and 15 Puzzle's custom colors) to the Appearance page's form; when ticked, the chosen color is used for the note's text and toolbar icons and for the scheme previews on that page.

commits.message:
applets/notes: allow choosing a custom text color

The text color of a sticky note was fixed by its color scheme, so the
transparent notes could be unreadable over a dark or busy wallpaper. Add
a custom text color option, used for the note's text and buttons.

BUG: 526305

media.caption: Transparent sticky note on a black wallpaper: the dark text is barely visible
Same note with a custom light yellow text color
Appearance settings on current master: only the font size and the color scheme
New "Text color: Custom" entry in the same form, aligned with the font size; the scheme previews show the chosen color

review.text: Small, opt-in config entry (off by default, so existing notes are unchanged) that overrides the scheme's text/icon color in both the note and the settings previews, using the same FormEntry + ColorButton pattern as other kdeplasma-addons applets. Before/after shots show the unreadable transparent note fixed and the new form row. Open MR kdeplasma-addons!1114 touches the same color logic, so expect to rebase or coordinate with it when submitting.
